shortDescription: Hungary posted a foreign trade surplus (HUTRD=ECI) of 69.0 million euros in July, the Central Statistics Office (KSH) said on Friday.Exports rose by an annual 10.8% in euro terms in July, while imports grew by 14.9% year-on-year, the KSH said.
